result.note: Brief item; tested the location of Vizhinjam port, the place in the news, using its August 2026 shift beyond transshipment as context.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, Vizhinjam port began import-export operations, moving beyond transshipment. In which state is Vizhinjam port located?
questions.explain: Vizhinjam is a Kerala port. On 19 August 2026 it began import-export operations, so it no longer handles only transshipment cargo.
questions.source: Kerala's Vizhinjam port began import-export operations, moving operations beyond transshipment.
